name: Research or publication input
about: Review a source, expert input, hypothesis, dataset or material critique
title: ""
---

## Original input and question

Exact public URL/version/date or authorized bounded summary. Do not paste private
correspondence without permission. What existing conclusion/question might change?

Clarify the intended question and material scope with the maintainer. Record
confirmed decisions and open questions; do not treat assumptions as agreed intent.

## Existing owners

Source/research IDs, relevant research/brief/manuscript/blueprint and issue links.
A candidate is not an accepted finding.

## Review plan

Search original input and existing source/research uses. Select the existing
repository flow. Produce an impact report for maintainer review before substantive
integration (methods, limitations, contradictions, affected claims/figures/protocols,
include/exclude/narrow/defer recommendation).

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] AC-1 — Exact source/version, metrics, uncertainty and limitations inspected.
- [ ] AC-2 — Every material use traced; wording, numbers and placement assessed;
  better destinations and contradictory/positive evidence recorded.
- [ ] AC-3 — Impact report and required maintainer decision recorded.
- [ ] AC-4 — Accepted changes independently reviewed and validated as required.
- [ ] AC-5 — Canonical records synchronized through their own procedures.
- [ ] AC-6 — PR and issue summaries map AC IDs to exact-source evidence and remaining work.

## Linked work and decisions

Owning PRs, cross-repository dependencies and dated scope/decision changes.
